name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.28-beta “Paris” (build 28) — Word add-in fix, part 2.
• The Word add-in no longer depends on your Normal template; this addresses “Compile error in hidden module: LitArbiRibbon”. It is rebuilt automatically the first time LitArbi starts with Word closed.
• New: Settings → Word Add-in → Check Word add-ins… shows which templates Word loads, tells the Windows add-in from the macOS one, and flags missing references. Repair moves problem templates aside (nothing is deleted) and rebuilds the add-in; Copy Report for support.
• Macintosh LitArbi templates in either Word startup folder are replaced automatically.
• Everything from build 26: full parity with macOS 0.9.28.
